id: 05_Compressed Gas Cylinders Major and Minor Leaks Equipment Safety
title: 压缩气瓶：大泄漏与小泄漏
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/05_Compressed Gas Cylinders Major and Minor Leaks Equipment Safety.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/05_Compressed Gas Cylinders Major and Minor Leaks Equipment Safety/src.py

points.K1: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用
points.K2: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回
points.K8: 可燃、助燃气体：移走可燃物
points.K15: 事故和未遂事件都要上报
points.K16: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身旁一排固定好的气瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway next to a row of strapped gas cylinders and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲气瓶的大泄漏和小泄漏。
overlay: 压缩气瓶：大泄漏与小泄漏

shots.scene: 阿杰在气瓶旁皱眉，听到嘶嘶声
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands near a gas cylinder, frowning and listening to a faint hissing sound.
shots.narration: 阿杰听到气瓶那边有嘶嘶声。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，示意他先别慌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and raises a calm hand to the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研说：先分大漏小漏，再按步骤办。

shots.section_title: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用
shots.scene: 锈迹斑斑、漆面剥落的气瓶瓶肩特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a gas cylinder shoulder covered in rust spots with peeling paint. No people.
shots.narration: 预防泄漏，先看气瓶的状况。
overlay: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用

shots.section_title: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用
shots.scene: 锈蚀气瓶挂上空白停用牌，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A rusty cylinder with a blank out-of-service tag and a red X over it. No people.
shots.narration: 锈蚀、腐蚀、损坏的，漏之前就停用。

shots.section_title: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回
shots.scene: 老周把一只不再使用的气瓶放上推车
shots.prompt_en: The older man places an unused gas cylinder on a cylinder cart to send it back.
shots.narration: 不再使用的气瓶，退回去。
overlay: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回

shots.section_title: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回
shots.scene: 戴手套的手指着瓶肩钢印，旁边月份和年份两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger points at stamped marks on a cylinder shoulder, with a small month icon and a year icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 钢印上的最近检验日期，按月和年读。

shots.section_title: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回
shots.scene: 日历图标翻过很多页，旁边气瓶退回箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with many pages flipped and an arrow sending a cylinder back to a supplier truck icon. No people.
shots.narration: 超过检验日期10年的，也要退回。

shots.scene: 小泄漏与大泄漏的分段标题，两只气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A clean title card with two cylinder icons, one with a thin wisp of gas and one with a big cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 怎样区分小泄漏和大泄漏？

shots.scene: 实验室插画，一只气瓶冒出一缕细细的白气，旁边红框四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab illustration with a row of cylinders, one releasing a thin wisp of white gas; a red frame beside it holds four small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 小泄漏：量少、缓慢、可以控制，

shots.scene: 惰性气体瓶图标，旁边低风险仪表
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an inert gas cylinder next to a low-risk gauge with the needle in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 惰性、不致窒息或低危害的气体。

shots.scene: 人员图标旁边绿色小盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with a small green shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 人员受伤和暴露的风险低。

shots.scene: 实验室插画，一只气瓶喷出大股黑烟，旁边红框三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab illustration with a cylinder releasing a large thick dark cloud; a red frame beside it holds three small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 大泄漏：量大、控制不住，

shots.scene: 人员、建筑、树木三个图标被红色警示三角包围
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a person, a building and a tree, surrounded by red warning triangles. No people.
shots.narration: 危害人员、设施和环境。

shots.scene: 有毒气体瓶冒出一缕细气，旁边骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A toxic gas cylinder with only a thin wisp of gas, next to a skull pictogram and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒、高危气体，漏一点也算大泄漏。

shots.scene: 喷壶检漏的减压器接口特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a spray bottle misting leak detection liquid onto a regulator joint. No people.
shots.narration: 发现了小泄漏，

shots.scene: 小研走向正在仪器前工作的阿杰，提醒他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over to the young male student working at an instrument and tells him about the leak.
shots.narration: 先通知周围的人。

shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on safety goggles and gloves over her lab coat.
shots.narration: 还没穿戴防护的，先穿戴好。

shots.scene: 小研手握瓶阀手轮检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student grips the cylinder valve handwheel and checks the valve closely.
shots.narration: 确认是气瓶本身在漏，

shots.scene: 扳手紧固后气泡仍在，旁边感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A wrench next to a valve that still shows bubbles, with an exclamation mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 紧固接头和阀门也解决不了。

shots.scene: 通风橱与万向排风罩并排
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood and a flexible local exhaust canopy side by side in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 安全的话，移进通风橱或排风罩下。

shots.scene: 一只气瓶固定在隔离的通风角落，四周空气流动箭头
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder secured in an isolated, well-ventilated corner with airflow arrows around it. No people.
shots.narration: 或者放到隔离、通风好的地方放空。

shots.section_title: 可燃、助燃气体：移走可燃物
shots.scene: 小研把纸箱从靠墙固定的两只气瓶旁移开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries cardboard boxes away from two cylinders strapped against the wall.
shots.narration: 可燃或氧化性气体，移走旁边的可燃物。
overlay: 可燃、助燃气体：移走可燃物

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰走出实验室门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student walk out of the lab door into the corridor.
shots.narration: 撤离附近区域。

shots.scene: 小研在门边贴上警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student posts a general warning sign on the lab door.
shots.narration: 贴出警示标志，不让别人进入。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边实验室和安全部门两个图标
shots.prompt_en: In the corridor, the female graduate student makes a phone call, with a lab icon and a safety office icon beside her.
shots.narration: 通知实验室负责人和安全部门。

shots.scene: 两人站在走廊门外，旁边沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student stand outside the closed lab door, with an hourglass icon beside them.
shots.narration: 留在区域外，等气瓶里的气放完。

shots.scene: 靠墙固定的两只气瓶，一只挂着空白故障牌
shots.prompt_en: Two cylinders strapped against the wall, one with a blank fault tag, and an arrow toward a supplier truck icon. No people.
shots.narration: 把气瓶退回供应商维修。

shots.scene: 大泄漏分段标题：两只灰色气瓶与减压器
shots.prompt_en: Two grey gas cylinders with regulators releasing a spreading cloud of gas, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 大泄漏，包括有毒气体的小漏，

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰快步离开实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student walk quickly out of the lab.
shots.narration: 立即撤离这个区域。

shots.scene: 手按下墙上的化学品泄漏报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses a blue chemical spill alarm button on a corridor wall. No people.
shots.narration: 启动楼内火灾或化学品泄漏报警。

shots.scene: 小研用手机拨号，旁边电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student dials on her mobile phone in a safe place outside, with a telephone icon beside her.
shots.narration: 拨打911，并通知安全部门。

shots.scene: 消防车红色警灯闪烁
shots.prompt_en: The red flashing lights of a fire engine arriving outside a building. No people.
shots.narration: 救援人员赶到了。

shots.scene: 小研向到场的保卫处值班员说明情况
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains the situation to the arriving security officer at the building entrance.
shots.narration: 把事件的详细情况告诉他们。

shots.section_title: 事故和未遂事件都要上报
shots.scene: 小研在电脑上填写空白的事件上报表，旁边二维码图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank online incident report form on a computer, with a QR code icon beside it.
shots.narration: 事故、事件和未遂事件，都要上报。
overlay: 事故和未遂事件都要上报

shots.section_title: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的气瓶安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank gas cylinder safety handbook.
shots.narration: 更多内容查气瓶安全指南，不懂就问。
overlay: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现锈蚀气瓶打叉、日历图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a rusty cylinder crossed out and a calendar.
shots.narration: 破损、过期的气瓶，及早停用退回。

shots.scene: 小泄漏流程：通知、防护、通风、撤离四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a speaking person, goggles, a fume hood and an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 小漏：通知、防护、通风放空、撤离。

shots.scene: 大泄漏流程：撤离、报警按钮、电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an exit door, an alarm button and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 大漏：撤离、报警、打电话、上报。

shots.scene: 欣欣在走廊里挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in a bright corridor outside a lab door.
shots.narration: 遇到漏气不慌张，下次见！
